channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — Chemistry
channel.description: Free chemistry study notes and revision guide with worked examples covering physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry.

item.title: Atomic Structure and Electron Configuration
item.description: Quantum numbers, orbital shapes, Aufbau principle, Hund's rule, Pauli exclusion, and periodic trends in atomic properties.

item.title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry
item.description: Valence bond theory, hybridisation, VSEPR model, molecular orbital theory, and predicting molecular shapes with worked examples.

item.title: Thermochemistry and Hess's Law
item.description: Enthalpy of reaction, bond energies, calorimetry, Hess's cycle, and standard enthalpies of formation and combustion.

item.title: Kinetics and Reaction Rates
item.description: Rate laws, order of reaction, Arrhenius equation, activation energy, and catalysis with worked calculations and graphs.

item.title: Equilibrium and Le Chatelier's Principle
item.description: Equilibrium constants, reaction quotients, Le Chatelier's principle, and applying equilibrium to industrial processes like the Haber process.

item.title: Alkanes and Cycloalkanes
item.description: Nomenclature, conformations, stereochemistry, and free radical substitution reactions of saturated hydrocarbons with mechanisms.

item.title: Alkenes and Addition Reactions
item.description: Electrophilic addition, Markovnikov's rule, hydrohalogenation, hydration, and polymerisation of alkenes with detailed mechanisms.

item.title: Alcohols, Ethers, and Epoxides
item.description: Nomenclature, physical properties, synthesis of alcohols, Williamson ether synthesis, and acid-catalysed reactions of epoxides.

item.title: Carbonyl Compounds
item.description: Aldehydes and ketones, nucleophilic addition, reduction, oxidation, and condensation reactions with Grignard reagents and aldol chemistry.

item.title: Carboxylic Acids and Derivatives
item.description: Nucleophilic acyl substitution, esterification, amide formation, and the reactivity series of carboxylic acid derivatives.

item.title: Transition Metal Complexes
item.description: Ligand types, coordination numbers, crystal field theory, colour, magnetism, and isomerism in transition metal complexes.

item.title: Acids, Bases, and Buffer Solutions
item.description: pH scale, weak acid and base equilibria, buffer calculations, titration curves, and the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation.

item.title: Electrochemistry and Redox Reactions
item.description: Oxidation states, standard electrode potentials, Nernst equation, galvanic and electrolytic cells, and applications to corrosion prevention.

item.title: Chemistry — Complete Guide
item.description: Free chemistry study notes covering physical chemistry, organic chemistry, and inorganic chemistry with worked examples and revision questions.
